sentences.en: She scraped her shoes clean before she entered the house.
sentences.zh: 她进屋前把鞋上的泥巴刮干净了。

sentences.en: Working together, they cleaned the entire house in no time.
sentences.zh: 两人合作很快就把整个屋子打扫干净了。

sentences.en: I want you to have this room clean and tidy.
sentences.zh: 我希望你把这间房整理得干干净净的。
